headline: Dollar Industries Limited: Shareholders meeting
sum: Shareholders meeting — Dollar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Court Convened General Meeting held on July 22, 2026 Outcome and Proceedings of the meetings of Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors…
detail: Shareholders meeting — Dollar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Court Convened General Meeting held on July 22, 2026 Outcome and Proceedings of the meetings of Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors convened on 22nd July, 2026, pursuant to NCLT Order dated 11th May 2026 .
